conventions.convention: The off-shell algebra is a free graded-commutative complex polynomial algebra over smooth spacetime coefficients, with each polynomial involving finitely many jets. The matter field is commuting. The ghost and antighost are odd; the auxiliary variable is even. The differential vanishes on spacetime coefficients, raises ghost number by one, and commutes with coordinate derivatives.

The normalized Abelian gauge convention is a′μ = aμ + ∂μα and ψ′ = exp(igα)ψ; correspondingly sψ = ig c_gh ψ and saμ = ∂μ c_gh. Spacetime has metric diag(−1,1,1,1), standard orientation, and length coordinate x⁰.

Doublet contraction uses left graded derivatives, a finite selected family of polynomial doublets, and independence of all other generator transformations from those doublets. The homotopy is h = Σj uʲ ∂L/∂vʲ.

Local horizontal forms have compactly supported smooth spacetime coefficients and polynomial finite-jet dependence. On a p-form, s is extended as (−1)^p times its coefficient action, so sd_H + d_Hs = 0. Relative cocycles and coboundaries are formed inside the same s,d_H-stable subcomplex.

The anomaly criterion concerns formal power series, n ≥ 1, and the quotient F_n^r = K_n^{r,4}/d_H K_n^{r,3}. K_n^{0,4} is exactly the admissible counterterm space. Nilpotence of the formal Ward operator and locality of the breaking are assumptions, separate from the scalar time-ordering theorem.

load_bearing.statement: The Abelian jet derivation s defined in the local BRST algebra satisfies s² = 0. For the stated finite doublet family, [N,s] = 0 and sh + hs = N. Consequently the inclusion of the doublet-independent polynomial subalgebra induces an isomorphism on polynomial BRST cohomology; if sa_k = 0 and Na_k = ka_k for k > 0, then a_k = s(ha_k/k).
Define the odd derivation s of ghost number one by saμ = ∂μc_gh, sc_gh = 0, s c̄ = B, sB = 0, and sψ = igc_ghψ, extended by the graded Leibniz rule and commutation with spacetime derivatives.

For an s,d_H-stable graded subcomplex K, H^{r,p}(s|d_H;K) is the quotient of forms a_p satisfying sa_p + d_Ha_{p−1} = 0 for some a_{p−1} in K by forms sb_p + d_Hc_{p−1}, with all primitives in the specified degrees of K.

Under its scalar-scheme, choice, subcomplex, locality, and nilpotent formal Ward-operator hypotheses, the first possible breaking density a₄ satisfies sa₄ ∈ d_H K_n^{2,3}. An admissible shift X ↦ X − ℏⁿ[b₄] cancels the order-n breaking if and only if [a₄] = 0 in H^{1,4}(s|d_H;K_n).
